summary: Mobile web preview loaded successfully. Level selection shows 10 deterministic levels, level 1 opens, tube selection, valid move, invalid move reset, undo, and restart interactions passed.
action_items: Consider adding explicit testID props to interactive controls and critical state labels for native regression testing; current web accessibility labels work.
critical_code_review_comments: No EXPO_BACKEND_URL key exists in frontend/.env, but this app intentionally has no backend/API integration.
Completion persistence and full puzzle solving were not exercised end-to-end in this pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use aria-label selectors for tubes (e.g. [aria-label^="Tubo 1,"]); data-testid attributes are currently absent. A full completion path and AsyncStorage best-score persistence still need verification.
rca_of_issue: No functional issue reproduced. The initial role-based tube selector was too broad/unsupported in the automation wrapper, but DOM inspection confirmed each tube is an accessible BUTTON with a Spanish aria-label; this was a test-selector limitation, not an app defect.
